declared_exclusions.item: A token from any store other than the estate's own loader
declared_exclusions.reason: Not used. The Secrets Manager read of the estate's loader succeeded (token_store_used secretsmanager), so no fallback was taken.

declared_exclusions.item: Any AWS write, push, deploy, or change to served values
declared_exclusions.reason: None made. The reads were the Secrets Manager token, the private dimension and the round-119 roster body, and the two Scope POST responses. Writes are the private folder, the repo record and the surprise rows.

Not an exclusion from the criterion: the criterion grades the record against the recount under the rule as written. The rule fails for all 9 series (series_complete_all false), which is recorded as a measured result and filed as IRPT_DASHBD-D2-W309-S2 for the issuer to rule; the rule was not changed.

surprises: IRPT_DASHBD-D2-W309-S1: the Orion loader modules orion_selected and orion_live were absent from the sparse worktree, so the first attempt stopped before any call; the coordinator ruled the sparse set the issuer's omission and the modules were added to it. Form only.
IRPT_DASHBD-D2-W309-S2: the Scope breakdown is basedOn Calendar, so each series counts calendar days and the trading-day completeness rule fails for all 9 series. Form only.

IRPT_DASHBD-D2-W309-S3: two long-history series (686 and 2228 points) are short of their calendar-day count from the roster start and their chains do not reproduce the summary return; the other seven reproduce it. Form only.
